title: Remove dead `onOpenEditor` prop from ViewConfigPanel
body:
Vercel build fails with TS6133 errors due to unused `onOpenEditor` callback pattern in ViewConfigPanel. The component handles all editing inline, making this prop dead code.

- **`ViewConfigPanel.tsx`**: Remove `EditorPanelType` type and `onOpenEditor` from `ViewConfigPanelProps`
- **`ObjectView.tsx`**: Remove `handleOpenEditor` callback, its type import, and prop passing
